name: aws_subnet
description: A range of IP addresses in your VPC for launching resources

enable_dns64.name: enable_dns64

enable_resource_name_dns_aaaa_record_on_.name: enable_resource_name_dns_aaaa_record_on_launch
enable_resource_name_dns_aaaa_record_on_.description: Respond to DNS queries with IPv6 address (AAAA record)

enable_resource_name_dns_a_record_on_lau.name: enable_resource_name_dns_a_record_on_launch

map_customer_owned_ip_on_launch.name: map_customer_owned_ip_on_launch
map_customer_owned_ip_on_launch.description: Map customer owned IP on launch (for Outposts)

outpost_arn.name: outpost_arn
